_note: What athenahealth does not know about each clinic, keyed by clinic id = practiceid:departmentid. Used when CLINIC_SOURCE=athena. THESE ENTRIES ARE FOR tools/fake_athena.py (fictional clinics). For real practices run `python tools/athena_setup.py overrides`: it rewrites this file from the live department list and keeps the entries you have filled in. Fields: short = name used in texts (18 characters or fewer). income = who the clinic is for: low (low income / Medicaid / uninsured), standard (other insurance or able to pay), all (default). needs = triage categories the clinic is known for (app/triage.py CATEGORIES, e.g. mental_health; dental and pediatrics once triage sorts them). appointment_types = what to book: default for every need, plus one entry per need; each is {appointmenttypeid} or {reasonid}, optionally with providerid. No default = any open slot. hidden = true keeps the clinic out of offers.
